script:
set -eu
for host in 172.31.42.209 172.31.37.239; do
 ssh -i /opt/karpo/.ssh/promo-rtx21 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new ubuntu@$host 'sudo snap restart amazon-ssm-agent; sudo systemctl status snap.amazon-ssm-agent.amazon-ssm-agent --no-pager | head -12'
done
ssh -i /opt/karpo/.ssh/demo-bootstrap -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new ubuntu@172.31.14.72 'sudo snap restart amazon-ssm-agent; sudo systemctl status snap.amazon-ssm-agent.amazon-ssm-agent --no-pager | head -12'
